_comment: Checksum manifest for the raw source files. NOT a download list -- the
dataset lives behind a Kaggle account, so acquisition is manual (see
README.md). `npm run verify` checks these hashes and refuses to proceed on
Why this file exists: the raw data is 710MB and cannot go in git, so the
repo alone does not pin what a load consumed. These hashes are what make
'my teammate got the same corpus' a checkable claim rather than a hope.
verify also writes them into corpus.etl_metrics, so the sealed corpus
carries its own provenance after staging is dropped.

dataset.name: Ifta Sunnah Hadith & Narrators Dataset
dataset.url: TODO: paste the Kaggle dataset URL here
dataset.note: Download the three files below into etl/raw/ (flat, no subdirectories).

optional_datasets.name: LK-Hadith-Corpus
optional_datasets.tree_sha256_recipe: find . -name '*.csv' -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum
optional_datasets.note: Optional. Absent -> stage 14 is a no-op and the corpus is Arabic-only. Not checked by `npm run verify`, which only pins the required Ifta files.
